{{Quote|Rage One to Team Enemy Mine, Team Shellfish. We are a go. I say again, we are a go.''"<br />"''Enemy Mine, understood. Go get 'em, soldier.''"<br />"''Shellfish here. Understood.|Voort saBinring, Trey Courser, and Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Team Shellfish''' was the name given to two members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to prove Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s corruption<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Jesmin Tainer]] and [[Huhunna]] were tasked with extracting fellow Wraith [[Turman Durra]], who had been working undercover as the unidentified species "Embassy-Who-Climbs" inside the [[Chakham Army Base]], headquarters of the elite Alliance army unit the [[Pop-Dogs]], which was founded and led by Thaal.<ref name="MK" />

After extracting Turmann and running him through an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] wash, Team Shellfish helped prevent a transport speeder carrying Pop-Dog reinforcements from reaching Thaal by throwing a custom [[Tear gas grenade|tear gas]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] created by [[Drikall Bessarah]], the Wraith's assigned [[Medic/Legends|medic]], at the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" />
